title: WP-Optimize (WordPress plugin, WordPress.org) - 1-star review
snippet: Ongoing issue with minify cache. Otherwise good plugin, but there is an ongoing issue with minify cache. On a larger sites it could take gigabytes of space. I had sites that would aggregate 15-20Gb of total minify cache resulting in site going down due to lack of hosting space. A few people have reported similar issue but it doesn't seem to be resolved for a long time. So stay away from this plugin if you have a large site or don't use minify!

title: UpdraftPlus (WordPress plugin, WordPress.org) - 2-star review
snippet: Only Paid Version Backs Up Critical Files. Might be OK if you're paying for the premium version, but the free version has serious limitations and can leave you in a bad position. For example, the free version does not backup the critical .htaccess or wp-config.php files. If you don't know what these are and you're just assuming you have a full "backup", good luck. Still looking for a better alternative.
